funding_use: The capital will be deployed to enhance their core voice-first AI technology, expand distribution networks across India’s school infrastructure, and broaden prep tools for competitive state and national examinations.
investors: DataAlpha.ai, White Swan Global, Angel Investors
lead_investor: DataAlpha.ai, White Swan Global (Co-led by both entities)
company_description: An India-first, deeptech educational platform developing emotionally intelligent and conversational AI learning companions to build India's AI-ready education ecosystem.
product_or_solution: A voice-first personal AI tutor powered by real-time audio conversation and a live interactive visual sketchpad that functions across 22 Indian languages.
target_market: K-12 students (specifically highly active among grades 9–12) and competitive exam aspirants preparing for board exams, JEE, NEET, and CUET across NCERT, CBSE, ICSE, and state boards.
business_model: B2C (Direct-to-student app utilizing a Pay-As-You-Go model) and B2B2C (Strategic partnerships with schools and publishers like ABP Education to white-label AI tutors)
